subject: Security feature bucket prioritization: audit streams, retention windows, BYOK interplay
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.z@clearhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security feature bucket prioritization: audit streams, retention windows, BYOK interplay

Team —

I pulled together a short list of incoming asks from Sales/CS (linked below) and want to compress these into prioritized buckets so Product/Infra can pick winners for Q3. Key themes across customers:

- Audit streams: more granular event types and export formats (Kafka vs. S3 sinks). ClearHealth needs near-real-time event exports for an external SIEM.
- Retention windows: customer requests for sub-30-day ephemeral windows for certain workloads plus long-term archival for e-discovery.
- BYOK/KMS: two customers are asking for BYOK with HSM-backed ERKs; KeySafe (vendor) provided a straw SLA.
- SSO/provisioning: tighter SCIM claims for role-scoped access auditing.

Ask: can Security/Product map these into 3 buckets (Must have for Dedicated/Private, Nice-to-have configurable toggles, Postpone) with high-level engineering estimates? We should call out any compliance blockers (SOC2/GDPR) that would push something into Must.

I've attached an initial evidence matrix and a short retention-proposals draft. I've also included Emily (ClearHealth) for visibility — they noted the Kafka export latency requirement in their intake.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben — quick ops feasibility check on streaming and current export SLA impact
2) Marissa — compliance mapping + whether this changes evidence gating for SOC2 audit scope
3) Priyom — uplift estimate & which infra teams we'd need to involve (orch, runtime, storage)
4) Grace — product prioritization guidance; how to slot into roadmap buckets

Please reply with a one-paragraph assessment and a RAG (red/amber/green) for each theme by EOD Thu so I can consolidate for the leadership sync.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security feature bucket prioritization: audit streams, retention windows, BYOK interplay

Naomi —

Quick feasibility notes from infra/ops:

- Audit streams: We have two exporters in staging (S3 and a lightweight Kafka connector). Kafka end-to-end latency averages 250–350ms in our US region under normal load; adding per-event enrichment (identity+policy tags) could add ~25–40ms. Scaling to a sustained export rate requested by ClearHealth (approx 250 reqs/s peak) looks doable on Dedicated pools but will require a parallelization change (SEC-1423). RAG: amber.

- Retention windows: Implementing sub-30-day ephemeral windows for specific tenant namespaces is architecturally straightforward (policy TTL + auto-compaction) but requires index changes in the audit store and an archival pipeline for long-term holds. Estimated 3–4 sprint effort across infra and storage. RAG: green for feasibility, amber for compliance gating.

- BYOK/KMS: KeySafe's proposed SLA looks reasonable but their HSM integration will require us to add an ERK wrapping flow and new key-rotation hooks. This touches customer key import and export controls. Effort estimate: 5–7 sprints (infra + security + onboarding). RAG: red due to compliance signoffs and HSM procurement path.

Attachments: I added a short ops-impact spreadsheet and a rough capacity sketch.

Ben
Senior Manager, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Security feature bucket prioritization: audit streams, retention windows, BYOK interplay

Adding compliance perspective — thanks Naomi. Highlights: 

- Audit streams: For external SIEM exports (e.g., ClearHealth), we need to ensure PII minimization and include an opt-in flag per customer contract. Exporting identity claims for every action will expand our evidence surface; if customers want full identity payloads, we'll need to document compensating controls. RAG: amber.

- Retention windows & e-discovery: Short windows (<=30 days) are OK for operational logs, but any records that could be subject to legal hold must be exempt. We should design a hold API and label flows now. This raises data classification work (I've started a draft in evidence_matrix.xlsx). RAG: green with policy caveats.

- BYOK/HSM: SOC2 auditors will want proof of key custody separation and rotation schedules. KeySafe's SLA includes rotation windows and attestations; still need formal legal review. Also need to confirm whether KeySafe's KMS supports per-tenant separation (multi-tenant ERK scopes). RAG: red until legal + auditor confirmation.

I've attached keysafe-sla.pdf and updated the evidence matrix. If folks can validate the policy exceptions column by EOD tomorrow I'll fold into a summary for leadership.

Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the rapid takes — summary and actions below.

Executive summary (for roadmap buckets):
- Must (Q3 candidate):
  * Retention: hold API + policy TTLs (green/fast) — required to meet customer legal-hold asks and to make short-window configs safe. (Jira: SEC-1423)
  * Audit export controls: add per-customer export opt-in and PII minimization toggles (amber; needs infra changes but limited scope).
- Stretch (Q3/Q4):
  * BYOK/HSM integration with KeySafe — high compliance value but non-trivial infra/legal work (red). Recommend pilot with 1 customer under a gating checklist.
- Postpone:
  * Wide telemetry enrichment on every event beyond standard minimal fields — deprioritize until exports are stable.

Immediate action items by owner:
1) Ben: open SEC-1423 with the capacity sketches you attached; include the Kafka perf profile and a proposed canary plan. Due: 2028-04-25.
2) Marissa: finalize the evidence_matrix.xlsx policy-exceptions column and add legal review notes for KeySafe SLA. Due: 2028-04-20.
3) Priyom: deliver a first-cut implementation plan (high-level epics + 8-sprint estimate) for retention + export opt-in. Include which teams to pull. Due: 2028-04-24.
4) Naomi: set up a 30-minute cross-functional sync with ClearHealth + KeySafe to align on pilot requirements (propose 2028-04-27).

I've created a stub ticket and linked it: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1423. Putting this in the roadmap as "security: customer export & retention controls" as discussed.

Grace
Group Product Manager, Security
Redwood Inference
